title: About the Edmund Hillary Fellowship
description: EHF supports Fellows to accelerate NZ’s innovation system by starting and scaling ventures, leveraging global connections, and providing mentorship/investment.
heading: About the Edmund Hillary Fellowship
body: #### **The Edmund Hillary Fellowship (EHF) was a community of innovators, entrepreneurs** **and investors committed to Aotearoa New Zealand as a basecamp for global impact.** **From 2016 to 2026, EHF connected people, ideas and investment in service of a simple belief:** ***Meaningful solutions to the world’s hardest challenges can be built from here.***

#### **EHF was founded in 2016 to give life to the Global Impact Visa, a New Zealand Government programme designed to attract global changemakers to Aotearoa. Over the decade that followed, more than 500 Fellows from 50+ nationalities joined the Fellowship, building businesses, backing ventures, and putting down roots across the country.**

#### **The Global Impact Visa (GIV) was a pathway for talented entrepreneurs, investors and changemakers to settle in New Zealand and contribute to its future. EHF was created to support GIV recipients: helping them build deep connections with New Zealand communities, businesses and opportunities, and to create positive impact from here to the world.**

#### **EHF was named after Sir Edmund Hillary, in honour of his values: humility, perseverance, tenacious leadership and service. The Fellowship was founded on a commitment to honouring Te Tiriti o Waitangi, expressed through its kawa and tikanga.**
